title: SSRF protection is consistently applied across all outbound HTTP
description: src/federation.rs:29-73, src/cards.rs:20-26,42, src/push.rs:264-268, src/delivery.rs:192-195. Every path that makes an outbound HTTP request goes through validate_outbound_url(): federation fetches, card fetches, push notification delivery, and activity delivery. The card client additionally disables redirects to prevent redirect-based SSRF bypass. The is_private_host() function covers IPv4 private ranges, IPv6 ULA, link-local, CGNAT (100.64/10), and loopback — comprehensive coverage.
